glosses: hello (when answering at the beginning of a call)
used to confirm that the person being addressed is listening, or to confirm if anyone is listening
hello! (implying someone is not paying attention to the obvious)

examples.text: Allô, en quoi puis-je vous être utile ?
examples.en: Excuse me, but do you need any help?

examples.en: "Hello? May I speak with Mary?" "Please wait a moment."
